title: Do You Need to Eat Protein Within 30 Minutes After Exercise?

scenes.text: Is the 30‑minute post‑workout protein window real?

scenes.label: Strict protein timing needed
scenes.text: The common belief says muscles only grow if protein is consumed within half an hour of training.

scenes.label: Total protein matters more
scenes.query: study daily protein intake vs timing
scenes.text: Research shows total daily protein matters more; a 2‑hour window after exercise is sufficient for most people.

scenes.label: Focus on Daily Goal
scenes.sub: Spread protein evenly across meals for best results.
scenes.text: Plan meals to hit your daily goal, not the clock.
Follow if your body is worth 60 seconds a day.

description: The “anabolic window” sounds urgent, but evidence says your overall protein intake is the real driver of recovery. Get the facts and simplify your nutrition plan. Follow for more myth‑busting fitness tips.
